text: I've been getting braces here for about two years. They keep me on a tight schedule, charging me every single fee. The doctor then simply said that he couldn't see a crack, possibly just receding gums, and prescribed sensitivity medication.

The total bill came to 1150 baht.

That's very expensive, and I don't think my condition will improve.

The only good thing was the polite staff.
